rawRequest.explicitParamsInput: preserve the supplied JSON value exactly and include the JSON-RPC params member, including when the value is null

privacy.lspctlControlledValues: Default errors, logs, Receipts, and manifests omit source contents and secret configuration values read or generated by lspctl.
privacy.serverControlledValues: Server error code, message, and data are lossless. Retained server log and stderr text is preserved losslessly without redaction within its declared retention and truncation bounds. These values may contain source contents or secrets and are sensitive.
privacy.protocolTrace: Explicit protocol tracing contains exact protocol payloads and is sensitive.

dependencyGate.graph: resolved non-development release dependency graph for every supported target and release feature set
dependencyGate.rustsecVulnerabilities: block when any applicable RustSec vulnerability advisory remains
dependencyGate.sources: block when any release dependency is not sourced from crates.io
dependencyGate.licenses: block unless every release dependency has a recorded review concluding its license expression is compatible with MIT OR Apache-2.0
dependencyGate.unmaintained: each RustSec unmaintained warning requires a recorded package, advisory, impact, rationale, and review decision; the warning alone does not block release

sessionTargeting.filterResolution: must resolve exactly one live Owner generation or fail session_selection_failed

previewCreation.sessionIdentityValidation: recompute from the selected Workspace, server, effective declaration, authorization, and immutable Owner inputs; reject a mismatch as a stale proposal

canonicalValueEncoding.finiteFloatPayload: IEEE-754 binary64 big-endian; negative zero normalized to positive zero
canonicalValueEncoding.arrayPayload: item count then encoded items in order
canonicalValueEncoding.objectPayload: entry count then entries ordered by unsigned UTF-8 key bytes; each entry is key-byte length, key bytes, encoded value
rejectedValues: integer outside signed-negative or unsigned-nonnegative 64-bit range

digestContracts.output: sha256: plus 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, except Session identity which uses sid_ plus the same 64 hexadecimal characters
digestContracts.domainEncoding: UTF-8 domain text followed by one zero byte

trustDeclaration.payload: canonical object of server name, canonical resolved executable path, and only effective launch fields whose highest-precedence source is project configuration

trustAggregate.payload: canonical object mapping every current project server name to its trustDeclaration digest, ordered by canonical object encoding

manifest.payload: canonical array of manifestEntry objects in canonical plan order

metadata.payload: canonical platform-tagged object containing every preserved metadata value

identifierContracts.sessionIdentity: sid_ plus lowercase SHA-256 hex of the sessionIdentity digest contract
identifierContracts.ownerGeneration: gen_ plus lowercase hex of 16 cryptographically random bytes
identifierContracts.previewId: prv_ plus lowercase hex of 16 cryptographically random bytes
identifierContracts.receiptId: the replaced Preview ID, or rcp_ plus lowercase hex of 16 cryptographically random bytes
identifierContracts.transactionId: txn_ plus lowercase hex of 16 cryptographically random bytes

replacement.placement: randomized sibling staging directory, backup directory, and journal in the destination parent on one filesystem
steps: write and verify the complete staged payload and marker
durably record destination, stage, backup, intended digest, prior digest, and intended outcome before renaming
rename an existing destination to the backup, then rename the complete stage to the destination
verify the destination marker and complete payload digest before reporting success
remove backup and journal only after verification and durable cleanup
replacement.interruption: the next install invocation must use the journal and whole-tree digests to finish the intended replacement or restore the complete backup; it must never merge trees or report success for absent, mixed, or unverified content
replacement.unsafeEntries: reject symlinks and Windows reparse points in the destination, stage, backup, or journal path

digest.pathEncoding: UTF-8 with slash separators; relative; no dot components

schemaNotation.ownedObjects: closed unless a field is explicitly json, json-object, map<...>, or lsp:...
schemaNotation.lspPassthroughRule: LSP-owned payloads retain unknown fields and are intentionally open

workspaceSelectionRules: Otherwise search upward from the target file directory, or current directory when no target file exists, for the nearest .lspctl.toml.
When no .lspctl.toml exists, use the current directory.
Do not infer a Git root.
Inputs implying different roots are workspace_selection_failed.
A read-only Document outside the Workspace requires explicit --workspace and --server; Mutations remain within the Workspace.
selectionRules: Otherwise an explicit --language-id matches route.language_id exactly.
Otherwise a file uses the longest matching route extension with ASCII case-insensitive comparison on every platform.
Equal-precedence matches naming different servers are server_selection_failed.
A Workspace-wide command without --server requires default_server.
Every selected server must resolve to a complete effective declaration; executables are never guessed.
documentLanguageIdRules: An explicit --language-id applies to every file explicitly synchronized by that invocation.
Otherwise derive each synchronized file independently from routes naming the selected server, using its longest ASCII-case-insensitive matching extension.
Before dispatch, fail server_selection_failed when a file has no matching route or equally specific matches name different language IDs.

mergeRules.servers: merge by server name then field

config.projectProvenance: A supplied project field remains project-sourced even when its effective value equals a lower-precedence value; any project-sourced launch field requires Trust.

exitCodes.0: Successful envelope, including empty, unchanged, previewed, applied, already_applied, restored, and accepted_current.
exitCodes.2: Invalid CLI, stdin, JSON, or source-position input.
exitCodes.3: Blocked before dispatch or local action by configuration, selection, Trust, capability, policy, protected state, or install conflict.
exitCodes.4: Temporarily unavailable or busy before work could safely begin or while a durable Application continues.
exitCodes.5: Query, server, transport, protocol, timeout, cancellation, size, or stale-Document failure.
exitCodes.6: Mutation was not applied: rejected, stale, busy after acceptance, cancelled, unknown, or rolled back.
exitCodes.7: Workspace Recovery is required or Recovery failed.
exitCodes.8: Internal lspctl fault. If no envelope can be serialized, one ASCII diagnostic line is written to stderr.
